'''Malika Sturm''' was the host of the centennial [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] race in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]]. Tickets to this event were sold for high prices.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Off to the Races}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1stm}}
